name: create_ruby_paginator
description: Creates a Ruby Paginator (ceil page count, page clamping) consumed by an existing Api class (cross-file)
prompts: lib/api.rb already exists and calls App::Paginator.new(items, per_page).page(n). Create lib/paginator.rb defining class App::Paginator so the Api works. Requirements: initialize(items, per_page); total_pages returns the number of pages using ceiling division (e.g. 5 items at 2 per page => 3 pages) and is at least 1 even for an empty list; page(n) returns a hash with keys :items (the slice of items for that page), :page (the effective page number), :total_pages, and :total (the item count). The requested page number must be CLAMPED into the range 1..total_pages - asking for page 99 returns the last page, asking for page 0 returns the first. Do not modify lib/api.rb.

setup_files.lib/api.rb:
require_relative "paginator"

module App
  class Api
    def initialize(items)
      @items = items
    end

    # Page size is fixed at 2 for this endpoint.
    def list(page)
      Paginator.new(@items, 2).page(page)
    end
  end
end

test_setup_files.test/paginator_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/api"

class PaginatorHiddenTest < Minitest::Test
  def setup
    @api = App::Api.new(%w[a b c d e])
  end

  def test_first_page
    assert_equal({ items: %w[a b], page: 1, total_pages: 3, total: 5 }, @api.list(1))
  end

  def test_middle_page
    assert_equal({ items: %w[c d], page: 2, total_pages: 3, total: 5 }, @api.list(2))
  end

  def test_last_partial_page
    assert_equal({ items: %w[e], page: 3, total_pages: 3, total: 5 }, @api.list(3))
  end

  def test_over_last_page_is_clamped
    assert_equal({ items: %w[e], page: 3, total_pages: 3, total: 5 }, @api.list(99))
  end

  def test_below_first_page_is_clamped
    assert_equal({ items: %w[a b], page: 1, total_pages: 3, total: 5 }, @api.list(0))
  end
end

reference_solution.lib/paginator.rb:
module App
  class Paginator
    def initialize(items, per_page)
      @items = items
      @per_page = per_page
    end

    def total_pages
      return 1 if @items.empty?
      (@items.size.to_f / @per_page).ceil
    end

    def page(n)
      tp = total_pages
      p = n < 1 ? 1 : (n > tp ? tp : n)
      start = (p - 1) * @per_page
      {
        items: @items.slice(start, @per_page) || [],
        page: p,
        total_pages: tp,
        total: @items.size,
      }
    end
  end
end
